Zoe: Idea: a 'Synth Choir' where each person picks a model mascot and sings one line as them. Tiny, silly, zero pressure. :notes::robot_face:
Arjun: Love it. I'll be 'Greedy-Gryphon-7' who always takes the last chorus token. :laughing:
Priya: I'm in. Mascot: 'Whisper-Willow' who mumbles the bridge. :shushing_face:
Ben: Can we have a runtime challenge: sing one line, but the line must include an inline code snippet. Example: `for token in chorus:` :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Zoe: Venue: kitchen table after standup. Time: 5:45pm. Quick poll: react with :one: Kitchen :two: Rooftop :three: Zoom. I'll tally in 12h.
Zoe: Prompt idea for inspiration:
```
System: You are a choir conductor for an overcaffeinated language model.
User: Sing the chorus of 'Take On Me' as if it's a release note, include one bullet and a regret.
```
Arjun: :one: for kitchen. Also bringing a kazoo.
Priya: :one: kitchen. I'll wear a hat.
Ben: :three: Zoom — can stream. If kitchen wins I'll pop in person.
sys-bot: Reminder: no amplified sound in kitchen after 6pm per facilities.
Zoe: OK kitchen by majority. Tiny prize: best mascot name wins a sticker and a useless metric (latency in ms of applause).
Priya: I'll prototype a sticker art: a tiny choir of quantized penguins. :penguin: 
Ben: Also lowkey want a 'debug-ballad' round where we sing commit messages. Could be ~30s microset.
Arjun: Count me in for 'debug-ballad'. Will open with: "refactor(chorus): reduce entropy" :guitar: 
Zoe: Sign-up sheet in 6h. Bring snacks, props, and bad puns. :chipmunk:
